intro.h2: A Wenatchee Remodeling Contractor That Also Frames, Sides and Roofs
paragraphs: Upper Left Construction is a licensed remodeling contractor in Wenatchee, and the logo says it plainly: framing, siding, roofing, remodels. The same crew can handle the structure of a project as well as the finished room.

You can see that in the work they share. On one house they tore out rotten siding and an old patio door, framed in a new living room window and buttoned up the outside with new siding. Their posts also show pole shops, metal roofing and a cedar fence on pressure-treated lumber. Reviewers call the work excellent quality and very detailed, and one says this company works hard and will get the job done.

items.name: Interior remodels and flooring
items.blurb: Interior remodels and new flooring, from revamping an outdated floor to flooring in a new build. Their photos include a room stripped back to the subfloor and ready for its new floor. Call to describe your room and talk through what the job would involve.

image.alt: Room with new windows and a bare subfloor, ready for new flooring

items.name: Siding and window changes
items.blurb: Rotten siding removed and replaced, old patio doors taken out and new windows framed in. On one house the crew added a window to the living room, then closed up the outside with new siding. Their posts describe it as another happy customer.

image.alt: Single-story white lap-sided house with green trim and shutters, a covered entry and a green roof

items.name: Roofing, patio covers and carports
items.blurb: Patio covers, carports, flat roofs and metal roofing. One Facebook post asks 'Patio cover? Carport? Flat roof?' and answers 'No problem', and their photos show a dark standing-seam metal roof with a neatly flashed vent pipe.

image.alt: Close view of a dark standing-seam metal roof with a flashed vent pipe

items.name: Shops, garages and storage buildings
items.blurb: Extra space for trucks, toys and storage. Their photos show pole buildings with roll-up doors, lean-to covers and man doors, and one of their posts offers to build the added space and storage you have been dreaming of.

image.alt: Brown metal-sided shop building with a white roll-up door, an open bay and a man door

items.name: Fences and decks
items.blurb: A partly fallen fence replaced with dog-eared cedar on pressure-treated lumber, and a low backyard deck with wide steps. They have also posted about building a space of its own for the family dog, so ask about that too.

image.alt: New dog-eared cedar privacy fence beside a garden bed with red roses

items.name: Framing and new builds
items.blurb: Framing is the first trade on their logo. Their photos include walls and a floor framed up on a wooded site and a two-story home with board-and-batten siding and an attached two-car garage set among the pines.

image.alt: Wood-framed walls and floor of a building under construction with trees behind

items.title: Licensed in Washington
items.text: Upper Left Construction lists its Washington contractor licence as UPPERLC801B1. You can look it up with the state before you hire, and it is a good habit for any project.

items.title: Structure, not just finishes
items.text: Framing, siding and roofing are part of the trade here, so a problem found behind a wall or under a roof can be handled by the same crew that is doing the remodel.

items.title: Detailed work
items.text: Christine R. sums up her job as excellent quality, very detailed. Another reviewer calls it great quality of work from an excellent company that works hard.

items.title: Big and small jobs
items.text: The work they share ranges from pole shops and a metal roof to one fence line or one added living room window. Call about the size of job you have, large or small.

about.text: Upper Left Construction is a Wenatchee contractor based at 125 N Wilson St. The year on the logo is 2018, and the business holds Washington licence UPPERLC801B1. The logo also sums up the trade: framing, siding, roofing and remodels. The work they share fits the area, with pole shops, metal roofing, cedar fences and homes set among the pines, and inside they handle remodels and flooring. On their Facebook page the team says it is here to handle any and all of your upcoming projects.

image.alt: Brown and black pole building with a green metal roof, a lean-to cover and a white man door among tall pines

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (509) 670-2392 or message the Facebook page with photos and a short description of the project you have in mind.

steps.title: Site visit and price
steps.text: The crew looks at the site, talks through what you want and prices the work you agree on.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The framing, siding, roofing or interior work gets done. On past jobs they have shared progress photos on Facebook as the work went along.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: Walk the finished project with the crew and check it against what was agreed.

service_area.text: Upper Left Construction is based at 125 N Wilson St in Wenatchee, Washington. The projects they share range from in-town houses with lawns and fences to shops and homes set in the trees. If you are in or near Wenatchee, call (509) 670-2392 or send a message to check whether your project is a fit and when the crew could get to it.

items.a: Yes. Upper Left Construction lists Washington contractor licence UPPERLC801B1. Homeowners can check any contractor's licence and bond status with Washington Labor and Industries before signing, which is a good habit for any project, large or small. You can also ask for proof of insurance when you get your price.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Framing, siding, roofing and remodels, as the logo says. That includes interior remodels and flooring, siding and window changes, patio covers, carports and metal roofs, pole shops and storage buildings, cedar fences, decks and new builds. If your project fits under one of those, call and describe it.

Google lists Upper Left Construction as open 24 hours, every day. The quickest way to start is to call (509) 670-2392 or send a message on Facebook with a few photos of the area and a short note about what you want done. Include your address so they can plan a visit.

items.q: Can you build a shop or garage?
items.a: Yes. Their photos include several pole buildings with roll-up doors, lean-to covers and man doors, and they have posted about building added space and storage for toys and vehicles. Bring your rough size, door needs and site location to the first call so they can talk through options.

Upper Left Construction is at 125 N Wilson St, Wenatchee, WA 98801, and works on homes and properties in and around Wenatchee. Call before stopping by, because a contractor's crew is often out on job sites, and calling first is the easiest way to make sure someone is there to talk with you.

final_cta.text: Call or message Upper Left Construction about your remodel, siding, roof or new building.
